logp.method_description: Using the previously reported shake flask approach, the log Po/w of the RAPTA complexes followed the previously described procedure. An orbital shaker was used to shake a known amount of each complexes in water (pre-saturated with n-octanol). The solution was centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 10 minutes to allow phase separation. Different ratios (0.5:1, 1:1, and 2:1) of saturated solutions were shaken for 20 minutes on an orbital shaker with presaturated n-octanol to get the partition coefficient. The absorbance of aliquots of the aqueous and octanol layers were measured with a UV-Vis spectrophotometer after adequate dilution.The concentrations of the complexes in each layer were estimated using the correspondingn molar extinction coefficients, and the partition coefficient (log Po/w) values were computed from the ratio.
